items.title: mw00/project-maya
items.excerpt: Project Maya - run GLM-5.3-Flash (321B MoE) and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (748B MoE) privately on your own GPU(s), from one card to 16, NVIDIA or AMD, Linux or Windows. Engine, server, dashboard, OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API, quant tools.
items.summary: Project Maya enables running large language models (GLM-5.3-Flash 321B MoE and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 748B MoE) locally on GPUs with engine, server, dashboard, and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs.
items.usefulness: Could reduce costs and latency if you build Python tools requiring private model inference across single to 16 GPUs on NVIDIA or AMD hardware.
items.to_verify: Whether quantization tools produce usable accuracy; documented compatibility across claimed GPU counts and operating systems.
